description: Retry a failed package task only when retryable is true. Reuses uploaded bytes and resumes the original publication or replacement, which can change a public or shared artifact. Poll upload_status until completed. Does not create a duplicate artifact.

share_token.description: Token from a user-provided share URL; carries only that share permission.

tenant_id.description: Destination tenant for creation; defaults to the account tenant.

name: artifact_site_upload_retry
title: Retry package processing
